messages.no_file: Screenshot wasn't saved to a file. Enable file saving in Settings → Screenshot.
messages.no_recorder: No screen recorder found. Install wl-screenrec or wf-recorder.
messages.share_file_too_large: File too large for anonymous upload (128 MB max). Add an X02 API key for larger files.
messages.window_snap_fallback: Window snap isn't supported on this compositor — drag a region instead.

panel.empty: Pick a tool. Results appear here.
panel.no_color: Pick a color to get started
panel.title: Screen Toolkit
panel.no_screenshot_preview: No screenshot preview available yet. Take a capture first!
panel.no_recording_preview: No recording preview available yet. Make a recording first!

annotate_keep_raw.description: Save the un-annotated capture to the shell's screenshot folder before the annotation editor opens. Off by default: the raw capture stays in a temporary file and only what you copy or save from the editor reaches your outputs.
annotate_keep_raw.label: Keep Raw Markup Captures

filename_format.description: Template for generated filenames. Extension is added automatically. Tokens: %Y %m %d %H %M %S.
filename_format.label: Filename Format

gif_max_seconds.description: Maximum duration in seconds for GIF recordings.
gif_max_seconds.label: Max GIF Duration

hide_cursor.description: Exclude the cursor from recordings. Screenshots never include the cursor.
hide_cursor.label: Hide Cursor in Recordings

hide_when_unused.description: Hide the bar widget when no recording is active. It will appear only while recording.
hide_when_unused.label: Hide When Unused

panel_mode.description: Layout of the main panel. Standard is the default dense grid; Legacy recreates the Noctalia-v4 layout.
panel_mode.label: Panel Mode

record_audio_in.description: Record the default microphone while recording.
record_audio_in.label: Record Microphone

record_audio_out.description: Record the desktop's audio output while recording.
record_audio_out.label: Record System Audio

record_codec.description: Video codec for gpu-screen-recorder fullscreen capture. h264 is the safest NVIDIA NVENC default; av1 needs a recent GPU.
record_codec.label: Fullscreen Codec

record_copy_to_clipboard.description: Copy the recording to clipboard when done instead of showing the save dialog.
record_copy_to_clipboard.label: Copy to Clipboard

record_fps.description: Frame rate for gpu-screen-recorder fullscreen capture (15–240).
record_fps.label: Fullscreen Frame Rate

record_skip_confirmation.description: Automatically save to disk when recording finishes, without showing the save dialog.
record_skip_confirmation.label: Skip Save Confirmation

selected_ocr_lang.description: Tesseract language code (e.g. eng, deu, fra). Can be combined with + (e.g. eng+fra).
selected_ocr_lang.label: OCR Language

share_skip_popover.description: Skip the share popover and copy the link straight to clipboard. A notification confirms.
share_skip_popover.label: Copy Link Directly

video_path.description: Where recordings are saved. Leave empty for ~/Videos.
video_path.label: Video Path

x02_api_key.description: Optional. Get a free key at up.x02.me for permanent links and larger files. Without a key, uploads use uguu.se (anonymous, 3h, 128 MB max).
x02_api_key.label: X02 API Key

x02_expiry.description: How long your shared links stay alive. Only applies when using an X02 API key.
x02_expiry.label: Link Expiry
